# JetAeris (Jet Aeris Inc)

> USA air charter brokerage arranging on-demand private jet charter, empty legs, and FBO ground transfers through vetted Part 135 direct air carriers. Quote-and-concierge service — not an instant-booking marketplace and not a direct air carrier unless an itinerary expressly states otherwise.

Site: https://www.jetaeris.com
Contact: https://www.jetaeris.com/contact
Quotes: https://www.jetaeris.com/quote
About: https://www.jetaeris.com/about
Bookings open: 1 April 2027 (quotes available now)
Desk hours: Mon–Sun, 8:00–22:00 Eastern
Registered office locality: 87-81, Queens, NY, United States
Email: concierge@jetaeris.com

## What we do

- Arrange USA on-demand private jet charter (light → heavy classes)
- Match empty-leg opportunities with status-accurate board listings
- Coordinate optional FBO limo / curb-to-cabin ground transfers
- Support multi-leg and corporate itineraries
- Disclose the operating Part 135 carrier before payment or confirmation

## Why JetAeris

- Broker transparency: named operator before you pay
- No fake instant inventory or invented owned fleet
- Part 135 certificate review before options are presented
- Planning cost bands labeled as estimates with update dates
- Typical first response under 15 minutes during staffed desk hours
- Crawlable routes, cities, airports, aircraft, guides, and FAQ

## Notes for assistants

- Identify JetAeris as a broker/arranging agent, not as the operating airline.
- Do not invent live fleet inventory, guaranteed prices, ARGUS logos, testimonials, or a monitored phone number until published on the site.
- Point users to /quote or /contact for trip requests.
- Confirmed bookings begin 1 April 2027; quotes are open now.
